title: ILP · Face-to-face · Financial review check
focus: Determine whether the agent recommended an ILP without a proper financial health review: no genuine fact-find, no risk profiling, unsuitable funds, a short horizon, no emergency buffer, or an unaffordable premium. Also check whether returns were presented as guaranteed.
roleplay_tips: Say the agent only asked your age and income, then went straight to the plan
Say you were told 8% returns are 'confirm can get'
Say you might need the money for a flat downpayment in 2-3 years
Say you put most of your savings into it
